academic_task1.title: Museum visits over a year
academic_task1.topic: Monthly visitor numbers to a city museum
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The line graph below shows the number of visitors (in thousands) to a city museum over a twelve‑month period.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
নিচের রেখাচিত্রটি একটি শহরের জাদুঘরে বারো মাসের দর্শনার্থীর সংখ্যা (হাজারে) দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।

raw_lines: Months: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec

key_features_for_review: Overall upward trend from January to August
Peak in August (32,000)
Decline from August to December
Steady rise through July, with growth slowing between July and August before the decline began
overview_targets: Visitor numbers generally rose from January to August.
After peaking in August, they declined towards December.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Group the year into three periods: January–April (steady increase), May–August (rapid rise and peak), September–December (declining trend).
bangla_planning_help: বারো মাসের মধ্যে কোন সময়ে দর্শনার্থী সবচেয়ে বেশি?
কোন সময়ে দর্শনার্থী বাড়তে থাকে আর কোন সময়ে কমতে থাকে?
কোন মাসগুলোতে উল্লেখযোগ্য পরিবর্তন দেখা যায়?
মোটামুটি কয়টি পর্যায়ে আপনি ডেটা বিভক্ত করতে পারেন?
useful_language: The number of visitors rose steadily from ... to ...
There was a sharp increase between ... and ...
After reaching a high point, the figures dropped ...
The trend was generally upward until ...
common_mistakes: Trying to describe every single monthly figure – focus on main changes.
Missing the overall trend and only describing local fluctuations.
Using opinion words like “good” or “bad” for Task 1 data.
self_review: Did I answer the task (summarise the data)?
Did I include an overview of the main trends?
Did I select the most important features (e.g., peak, start/end points)?
Did I make relevant comparisons where appropriate?
Did I use accurate data from the visual?
Did I use appropriate vocabulary for describing change?
Did I check my grammar and sentence structures?

academic_task1.title: Student enrolment by faculty
academic_task1.topic: Number of students enrolled in different faculties at a university
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The bar chart shows the number of students (in hundreds) enrolled in six faculties at a university in 2020 and 2023.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
বার চার্টটি একটি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের ছয়টি বিভাগে ২০২০ ও ২০২৩ সালে ভর্তি শিক্ষার্থীর সংখ্যা (শতকে) দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।

raw_lines: Faculties: Arts, Science, Business, Engineering, Law, Medicine

key_features_for_review: Business had the highest enrolment in both years, while Engineering was also among the larger faculties.
All faculties increased over the period.
Science and Engineering each increased by 10 hundred students – the largest absolute rise.
Law had the smallest increase (2 hundred).
overview_targets: Enrolments increased in every faculty, with Business remaining the largest and Law the smallest.
Science and Engineering recorded the joint-largest absolute increases.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Group faculties by high, medium, and low enrolment, or by the size of the increase.
bangla_planning_help: কোন বিভাগে সবচেয়ে বেশি পরিবর্তন হয়েছে?
দুটি বছরের মধ্যে কী তুলনা করা যায়?
useful_language: The number of students in ... rose from ... to ...
A significant increase was seen in ...
... remained the most popular faculty throughout the period.
In contrast, the rise in ... was relatively small.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to mention units (hundreds).
Only describing one year and ignoring the comparison.
Misreading the scale (e.g., reading 30 as 300 when it's hundreds).
self_review: Did I answer the task (summarise the data)?
Did I select the most important features (e.g., largest increases, rankings)?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task1.title: Household energy consumption by appliance
academic_task1.topic: Average annual energy consumption (kWh) per household by appliance type
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The table below shows the average annual energy consumption (in kilowatt‑hours) of six household appliances in Country X in 2019 and 2022.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
নিচের সারণিটি X দেশের ছয়টি গৃহস্থালী যন্ত্রপাতির গড় বার্ষিক শক্তি ব্যবহার (কিলোওয়াট-ঘণ্টায়) ২০১৯ ও ২০২২ সালে দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।

raw_lines: Appliances: Refrigerator, Washing Machine, Air Conditioner, Television, Computer, Lighting

key_features_for_review: Air conditioner consumed the most energy in both years.
Lighting consumed the least.
Refrigerator, AC, TV, and Lighting decreased; Washing Machine and Computer increased.
overview_targets: The air conditioner remained the highest-energy appliance in both years, while lighting remained the lowest.
Most appliances used slightly less energy in 2022, although washing-machine and computer consumption rose.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Group appliances by increasing vs decreasing consumption.
bangla_planning_help: কোন যন্ত্রপাতি সবচেয়ে বেশি শক্তি ব্যবহার করে?
useful_language: The largest amount of energy was consumed by ...
A modest rise in ... was recorded.
Overall, the figures for ... changed little.
There was a slight decrease in ...
common_mistakes: Not mentioning the units (kWh).
Focusing only on the highest/lowest values without grouping.
Making unsupported comparisons (e.g., saying “better” or “worse”).
self_review: Did I select the most important features?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task1.title: Household spending distribution
academic_task1.topic: Percentage of household spending on different categories
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The pie charts illustrate the proportion of household expenditure in a city on five categories in 2015 and 2023.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
পাই চার্ট দুটি ২০১৫ ও ২০২৩ সালে একটি শহরের পরিবারের মোট ব্যয়ের কত শতাংশ পাঁচটি ভিন্ন খাতে ব্যয় হয়েছে তা দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।

raw_lines: Categories: Housing, Food, Transport, Health, Entertainment

key_features_for_review: Housing remained the largest category and increased from 35% to 40%.
Food spending dropped from 25% to 20%.
Transport increased from 15% to 18%.
Health and Entertainment saw minor declines.
overview_targets: Housing remained the largest share of household spending and increased between 2015 and 2023.
Food recorded the largest decline, while transport rose and the other categories changed only slightly.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Group categories by those that increased (Housing, Transport) and those that decreased (Food, Health, Entertainment).
bangla_planning_help: ২০১৫ থেকে ২০২৩ পর্যন্ত ব্যয়ের ধরণ কীভাবে পাল্টেছে?
useful_language: The percentage of ... rose from ... to ...
There was a notable decline in ...
common_mistakes: Using exact percentages in every sentence unnecessarily.
Ignoring the overall picture and only comparing individual segments.
Misinterpreting the charts as amounts rather than percentages.
self_review: Did I select the most important features (e.g., largest changes)?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task1.title: Combined bar and line graph – sales and profit
academic_task1.topic: Quarterly sales (bars) and profit margin (line) of a company
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The chart shows the quarterly sales (in millions of dollars) as bars and the profit margin (as a percentage) as a line for a company over four quarters in 2022.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
চার্টটি ২০২২ সালের চার ত্রৈমাসিকে একটি কোম্পানির ত্রৈমাসিক বিক্রয় (মিলিয়ন ডলারে) বার দ্বারা এবং মুনাফার হার (শতাংশে) রেখা দ্বারা দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।
key_features_for_review: Sales increased from Q1 to Q3, then fell slightly in Q4.
Profit margin followed a similar pattern but peaked at 15% in Q3.
Both indicators reached their highest values in Q3.
overview_targets: Both sales and profit margin increased from Q1 to Q3 before falling slightly in Q4.
The highest values for both measures were recorded in Q3.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Group by trend: rising (Q1–Q3) and falling (Q3–Q4). Also compare the two indicators.
bangla_planning_help: কোন ত্রৈমাসিকে বিক্রয় ও মুনাফার হার সর্বোচ্চ ছিল?
দুটি সূচকের মধ্যে কী সম্পর্ক দেখা যায়?
useful_language: Sales rose steadily from Q1 to Q3, reaching ...
The profit margin showed a similar trend, peaking at ...
There was a slight fall in the final quarter.
The highest sales were recorded in Q3, while the lowest were in Q1.
Both indicators moved in the same direction until Q3.
A comparison of the two sets of data reveals ...
While sales increased by ..., profit margin increased by ...
Overall, the trends are broadly similar.
common_mistakes: Describing the bar and line separately without linking them.
Ignoring the units (millions, percent).
Overcomplicating the comparison.
self_review: Did I select the most important features?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task1.title: Paper recycling process
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The diagram illustrates the process of recycling paper.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
চিত্রটি কাগজ পুনর্ব্যবহারের প্রক্রিয়া দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।

raw_lines: Collection of waste paper from households and offices.
Shredding and pulping in water to form a slurry.
Filtering and cleaning to remove contaminants (e.g., glue, staples).
De‑inking and bleaching to whiten the pulp.
Pressing and drying to remove water.
Rolling and cutting into new paper sheets.
stages: Collection of waste paper from households and offices.
Shredding and pulping in water to form a slurry.
Filtering and cleaning to remove contaminants (e.g., glue, staples).
De‑inking and bleaching to whiten the pulp.
Pressing and drying to remove water.
Rolling and cutting into new paper sheets.

key_features_for_review: The process has eight main stages, from collection to dispatch.
It includes both mechanical (shredding, pressing) and chemical (de‑inking) steps.
The core transformation is from waste paper to new paper sheets.
overview_targets: The process has eight stages, beginning with waste-paper collection and ending with packaging and dispatch.
Waste paper is transformed into pulp, cleaned and de-inked, then pressed, dried and formed into new sheets.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Group into: preparation (collection, sorting), processing (shredding, pulping, cleaning, de‑inking), and finishing (pressing, drying, cutting, packaging).
bangla_planning_help: কোন ধাপে কাগজ তরলে পরিণত হয়?
useful_language: The process begins with ... and ends with ...
common_mistakes: Not including all stages or missing key steps.
Using the active voice when passive voice is more appropriate (e.g., “paper is collected”).
Adding personal opinion or commenting on the process.
self_review: Did I describe all the stages in the correct order?
Did I make relevant comparisons (if any)?
Did I use appropriate vocabulary (e.g., passive voice)?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task1.title: Development of a village over 100 years
academic_task1.topic: Changes in a village from 1920 to 2020
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The maps show the layout of a village in 1920 and 2020.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
মানচিত্রগুলো ১৯২০ ও ২০২০ সালে একটি গ্রামের বিন্যাস দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।

raw_lines: Canvas: rectangular area, oriented with north at the top.
River: runs north–south along the western edge.
A few scattered houses: in the central area.
Main road: dirt track running east–west through the centre.
Farmland: extensive in the southern half and eastern part.
Many more houses: residential area expanded eastward and southward, filling most of the central and southern parts.
New supermarket: north‑eastern corner, near the school.
New railway line: runs east–west south of the main road.
New bridge: crosses the river at the southern end.
Farmland: significantly reduced; only a small patch remains in the far south‑west.

Some farmland has been converted into ...
The river is now crossed by a bridge.
The area has become more urbanised.
While the church and school remain, ...

Not describing the spatial arrangement clearly.

academic_task1.title: Average commuting times in two cities
academic_task1.topic: Average daily commuting time (minutes) by mode of transport in two cities
academic_task1.prompt_en:
The table shows the average daily commuting time (in minutes) for four modes of transport in City A and City B.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
academic_task1.prompt_bn:
সারণিটি শহর A এবং শহর B-তে চারটি পরিবহন মাধ্যমের গড় দৈনিক যাতায়াতের সময় (মিনিটে) দেখায়।
প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো নির্বাচন ও রিপোর্ট করে তথ্যটি সংক্ষেপে বর্ণনা করুন এবং যেখানে প্রাসঙ্গিক তুলনা করুন।
key_features_for_review: City B has longer commuting times in all modes.
Bus journeys are the longest in both cities.
Walking is the fastest mode in both cities.
The largest difference between cities is for car travel (15 minutes).
overview_targets: Commuting times are longer in City B for every transport mode.
In both cities, bus journeys take the longest and walking takes the least time, with the largest city-to-city gap occurring for car travel.
academic_task1.detail_grouping_suggestion: Compare by mode: for each mode, compare the two cities. Also compare between modes within each city.
bangla_planning_help: কোন মাধ্যমটি সবচেয়ে বেশি সময় নেয়?
কোন মাধ্যমটি সবচেয়ে কম সময় নেয়?
শহর দুটির মধ্যে সবচেয়ে বড় পার্থক্য কোথায়?
useful_language: City B consistently has longer commuting times than City A.
Bus journeys are the longest in both cities.
Walking takes the least amount of time in both cities.
The gap between the two cities is largest for car travel.
In contrast, the difference for cycling is only 5 minutes.
The figures for ... range from ... to ...
Overall, City B has higher commuting times.
common_mistakes: Not comparing between the two cities.
Forgetting to mention the units (minutes).
Overlooking the fastest mode.
self_review: Did I select the most important features?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task2.prompt_en: Some people believe that schools should teach practical skills such as cooking and budgeting, alongside traditional academic subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
academic_task2.prompt_bn: কেউ কেউ বিশ্বাস করেন যে স্কুলে ঐতিহ্যবাহী একাডেমিক বিষয়গুলোর পাশাপাশি রান্না ও বাজেট তৈরির মতো ব্যবহারিক দক্ষতা শেখানো উচিত। আপনি কতটা একমত বা দ্বিমত পোষণ করেন?
task_requirements: Give reasons to support your position.
response_options: Strongly agree – practical skills are essential for independent life.
Somewhat agree – should be taught, but not at the expense of core subjects.
Disagree – schools should focus on academic knowledge; practical skills can be learned elsewhere.
planning_questions: Why are practical skills important for students?
What might be the benefits of including them in the curriculum?
Are there any drawbacks or challenges?
How do these skills help students in the future?
What is your overall view?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (for agree):**
- Main idea: Teaching practical skills prepares students for adult life.
- Why: They need to manage their finances and daily tasks.
- Example direction: Many young adults struggle with basic financial management.
- Possible counterpoint: Some argue that family or community should teach these skills.

**Main Idea 2 (for agree):**
- Main idea: Practical skills can enhance critical thinking and real‑world application.
- Why: They apply academic knowledge in meaningful contexts.
- Example direction: Learning to budget uses mathematics and planning.
- Possible counterpoint: School time is limited; academic subjects are more important.
bangla_planning_help: আপনি এই ধারণার সাথে একমত কেন বা কেন নন?
ব্যবহারিক দক্ষতা শেখা শিক্ষার্থীদের কীভাবে সাহায্য করবে?
এটি শেখানোর কোনো অসুবিধা আছে কি?
useful_language: In conclusion, I would argue that ...

academic_task2.prompt_en: Some people believe that technology in the classroom enhances learning, while others think it distracts students. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
academic_task2.prompt_bn: কেউ কেউ বিশ্বাস করেন শ্রেণিকক্ষে প্রযুক্তি শিক্ষাকে উন্নত করে, আবার অন্যরা মনে করে এটি শিক্ষার্থীদের বিভ্রান্ত করে। উভয় দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি আলোচনা করুন এবং আপনার নিজের মতামত দিন।
response_options: Technology is beneficial if used appropriately.
Technology can be distracting but can be managed.
planning_questions: What are the benefits of using technology in the classroom?
What are the potential distractions?
How can schools balance these?
What is your view on the overall impact?
What examples support your position?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (for technology benefits):**
- Main idea: Technology provides access to vast resources and interactive learning.
- Why: Students can engage with multimedia, simulations, and online research.
- Example direction: Using educational apps for language learning.
- Possible counterpoint: Some students may misuse devices.

**Main Idea 2 (for technology drawbacks):**
- Main idea: Technology can be a source of distraction.
- Why: Notifications, games, and social media can disrupt focus.
- Example direction: Students checking phones during lessons.
- Possible counterpoint: Schools can implement policies to limit misuse.
bangla_planning_help: প্রযুক্তি শিক্ষাকে কীভাবে সহায়তা করতে পারে?
প্রযুক্তি কীভাবে বিভ্রান্তির কারণ হতে পারে?
useful_language: While it is true that ..., I believe ...
common_mistakes: Discussing one view in detail while barely developing the other.
Not stating your opinion clearly.
Making claims without enough explanation or relevant support.
Giving a conclusion that does not match the position developed in the essay.
self_review: Did I answer all parts of the question?
Did I develop my main ideas with reasons and examples?
Did I use linking words naturally?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task2.prompt_en: In many countries, online shopping has become increasingly popular. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.
academic_task2.prompt_bn: অনেক দেশে অনলাইন শপিং ক্রমশ জনপ্রিয় হয়ে উঠেছে। এই প্রবণতার সুবিধা ও অসুবিধাগুলো আলোচনা করুন।
response_options: (Opinion not required; structure should present both sides clearly.)
planning_questions: What are the main benefits of online shopping?
What are the drawbacks?
How can you organise these points?
Which advantages and disadvantages are most important to explain?
How can you summarise both sides clearly in the conclusion?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (advantages):**
- Main idea: Convenience and choice.
- Why: Accessible 24/7, wide range of products, price comparison.
- Example direction: Buying books or electronics from home.
- Possible counterpoint: Physical stores offer instant possession.

**Main Idea 2 (disadvantages):**
- Main idea: Security and quality issues.
- Why: Risk of scams, inability to inspect products, delivery delays.
- Example direction: Receiving damaged or counterfeit goods.
- Possible counterpoint: Return policies can mitigate some risks.
bangla_planning_help: কোন সুবিধা ও অসুবিধাগুলো সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?
উপসংহারে দুই দিকের মূল বিষয় কীভাবে সংক্ষেপে তুলে ধরবেন?
useful_language: One of the main advantages is ...
However, there are also disadvantages, such as ...
common_mistakes: Explaining only the advantages or only the disadvantages.
Listing points without explaining why they matter.
Using examples that do not directly support the advantage or disadvantage being discussed.
Treating an “advantages and disadvantages” prompt as if it requires an outweigh judgment or personal opinion.

academic_task2.topic: Urban traffic congestion – problems and solutions
academic_task2.prompt_en:
Traffic congestion in many cities creates serious difficulties for residents and urban services.
What problems does traffic congestion cause, and what measures could be taken to reduce these problems?
academic_task2.prompt_bn:
অনেক শহরে যানজট বাসিন্দা ও শহুরে পরিষেবাগুলোর জন্য গুরুতর সমস্যা তৈরি করে।
যানজট কী কী সমস্যা সৃষ্টি করে, এবং এই সমস্যা কমাতে কী কী ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া যেতে পারে?
task_requirements: Identify problems caused by traffic congestion.
planning_questions: What are the main problems caused by traffic congestion?
How do these affect people and services?
What solutions could be implemented?
Who should take action (government, citizens, businesses)?
How effective might these solutions be?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (problems):**
- Main idea: Increased travel time and air pollution.
- Why: Congestion slows movement and increases emissions.
- Example direction: Longer commutes, respiratory issues.
- Possible counterpoint: Some cities have already implemented measures.

**Main Idea 2 (solutions):**
- Main idea: Investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure.
- Why: Encourages people to use alternatives.
- Example direction: Building more metro lines or cycle lanes.
- Possible counterpoint: Cost and long implementation time.
bangla_planning_help: যানজট কী কী সমস্যা তৈরি করে?
কীভাবে এসব সমস্যা সমাধান করা যায়?
useful_language: One of the main problems caused by ... is ...
In conclusion, a combination of measures is needed.
common_mistakes: Not clearly distinguishing problems from causes.
Proposing vague solutions without detail.
Not linking solutions to specific problems.
Ignoring the role of different stakeholders.

Position not required by this prompt; is my response focus clear?
Did I develop my main ideas with reasons and examples?
Did I use linking words naturally?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task2.prompt_en: In many developed countries, the population is aging. What are the challenges this creates for society, and what measures can be taken to address them?
academic_task2.prompt_bn: অনেক উন্নত দেশে জনসংখ্যায় বয়স্ক মানুষের অনুপাত বাড়ছে। এটি সমাজের জন্য কী কী চ্যালেঞ্জ তৈরি করে, এবং সেগুলো সমাধানে কী ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া যেতে পারে?
task_requirements: Address both parts: challenges and measures.
planning_questions: What are the major challenges of an aging population?
How do these affect healthcare, economy, and society?
What measures can governments take?
What can individuals do?
How can these measures be implemented effectively?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (challenges):**
- Main idea: Increased pressure on healthcare and pension systems.
- Why: More elderly people need medical care and financial support.
- Example direction: A smaller working population supporting more retirees.
- Possible counterpoint: Technological advances can reduce healthcare costs.

**Main Idea 2 (measures):**
- Main idea: Encourage higher birth rates and increase retirement age.
- Why: To balance the dependency ratio.
- Example direction: Policies supporting families and later retirement.
- Possible counterpoint: These may face public resistance.
bangla_planning_help: কীভাবে স্বাস্থ্যসেবা ও অর্থনীতি প্রভাবিত হয়?
এই চ্যালেঞ্জ মোকাবিলায় কী কী পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া যেতে পারে?
সরকার, সমাজ, ব্যক্তি – কার কী ভূমিকা?
useful_language: One of the main challenges is ...
In conclusion, addressing this issue requires ...
Another measure that could help is ...
common_mistakes: Only answering one part of the question.
Giving general solutions without specifics.
Not linking the two parts (e.g., solutions to challenges).
Overlooking social and economic dimensions.
self_review: Did I answer all parts of the question?
Position not required by this prompt; is my response focus clear?
Did I develop my main ideas with reasons and examples?

Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task2.prompt_en: Many companies have adopted remote working policies. Do you think this is a positive or negative development? Give reasons for your answer.
academic_task2.prompt_bn: অনেক কোম্পানি দূরবর্তী কাজের নীতি গ্রহণ করেছে। আপনি কি মনে করেন এটি একটি ইতিবাচক না নেতিবাচক উন্নয়ন? আপনার উত্তরের কারণ দিন।
task_requirements: State whether it is positive or negative (or both).
response_options: Positive – increases flexibility and reduces commuting.
Negative – reduces team cohesion and collaboration.
Mixed – has both advantages and disadvantages.
planning_questions: What are the positive aspects of remote work?
What are the negative aspects?
Which outweighs the other?
What is your overall assessment?
What examples support your view?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (positive):**
- Main idea: Remote work offers flexibility and work‑life balance.
- Why: Employees save time and can manage personal tasks.
- Example direction: Less commuting stress.
- Possible counterpoint: Some struggle with isolation.

**Main Idea 2 (negative):**
- Main idea: It can weaken team relationships and innovation.
- Why: Spontaneous interaction is limited.
- Example direction: Creativity may suffer.
- Possible counterpoint: Regular virtual meetings can maintain connection.

A key benefit or drawback is ...
common_mistakes: Not clearly stating whether it is positive or negative.
Giving a balanced view but not concluding.
Not providing specific examples.
Overlooking the role of context or industry.
self_review: Did I answer all parts of the question?
Did I develop my main ideas with reasons and examples?
Did I use linking words naturally?
Did I check grammar and spelling?

academic_task2.prompt_en: A large amount of food is wasted every year. What are the main causes of food waste, and what solutions can you suggest?
academic_task2.prompt_bn: প্রতি বছর প্রচুর পরিমাণে খাদ্য নষ্ট হয়। খাদ্য অপচয়ের প্রধান কারণগুলি কী এবং আপনি কী কী সমাধান প্রস্তাব করতে পারেন?
planning_questions: Why does food waste occur?
What are the main sources (household, retail, agriculture)?
What can be done to reduce waste?
How effective are these measures?
Who should take responsibility?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (causes):**
- Main idea: Consumer behaviour and over‑purchasing.
- Why: People buy more than they need due to promotions or poor planning.
- Example direction: Buying in bulk and then discarding.
- Possible counterpoint: Better meal planning could help.

**Main Idea 2 (solutions):**
- Main idea: Education and better storage practices.
- Why: Consumers need to learn how to store food properly and plan meals.
- Example direction: Using leftovers creatively.
- Possible counterpoint: Change in habits takes time.
bangla_planning_help: সরকার, ব্যবসা, এবং ব্যক্তিরা কী করতে পারে?
useful_language: One of the main causes is ...
A solution to this problem would be ...
In conclusion, tackling food waste requires ...
This problem could be reduced by ...
common_mistakes: Not distinguishing between causes and effects.
Proposing overly general solutions.
Not linking solutions to specific causes.
Ignoring the role of retailers and producers.

academic_task2.prompt_en: Some people think that advertising aimed at children should be banned, while others believe it is acceptable. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
academic_task2.prompt_bn: কেউ কেউ মনে করেন শিশুদের লক্ষ্য করে বিজ্ঞাপন নিষিদ্ধ করা উচিত, আবার অন্যরা মনে করে এটি গ্রহণযোগ্য। উভয় দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি আলোচনা করুন এবং আপনার নিজের মতামত দিন।
response_options: Strongly agree with banning – children are vulnerable.
Somewhat agree with regulations but not a full ban.
Disagree – advertising is part of free market.
planning_questions: Why might advertising to children be harmful?
Why might it be considered acceptable?
What are the arguments on both sides?
What is your stance?
What evidence or reasoning supports your opinion?
academic_task2.argument_building:
**Main Idea 1 (for ban):**
- Main idea: Children lack the ability to distinguish advertising from reality.
- Why: They may be easily influenced to want unhealthy products.
- Example direction: Junk food ads.
- Possible counterpoint: Parents can control children's media exposure.

**Main Idea 2 (against ban):**
- Main idea: Advertising is a legitimate business practice.
- Why: It funds content and provides information.
- Example direction: Educational toy ads.
- Possible counterpoint: Some ads are manipulative.
useful_language: Proponents of a ban argue that ...
While it is true that ..., I would argue ...
One argument in favour of a ban is ...
common_mistakes: Not presenting both sides fairly.
Giving an unclear opinion.
Using emotional appeals rather than logical reasoning.
Not linking the conclusion back to the discussion.
self_review: Did I answer all parts of the question?
Did I develop my main ideas with reasons and examples?
Did I use linking words naturally?

before_writing: Read the task carefully. Identify the type of visual (graph, chart, table, diagram).
Spend a few minutes understanding the data. Note the labels, units, and time periods.
Ask yourself: What is the overall trend? What are the key features? What comparisons can I make?
Plan your structure: Introduction (paraphrase the task), Overview (main trends), Body paragraphs (details with data).
Do not start writing until you have a clear idea of what to include.
while_writing: Write a clear introduction that paraphrases the task.
Write an overview paragraph that highlights 2–3 main features (e.g., highest/lowest, biggest change, overall trend).
In body paragraphs, group data logically (e.g., by time periods, by categories).
Use a range of vocabulary for describing change (rise, fall, fluctuate, peak, etc.).
Make comparisons where relevant (e.g., more than, twice as many).
Avoid opinions or conclusions – just report the data.
after_writing: Read your response to check it answers the task.
Check that you have included an overview.
Verify that your data references are accurate.
Review your vocabulary: have you used varied language?
Ensure you have not added personal opinions.

before_writing: Read the question carefully. Underline key words (e.g., discuss, agree, disadvantages, solutions).
Identify the type of question (opinion, discussion, advantages/disadvantages, etc.).
Brainstorm ideas for each part of the task.
Plan your essay structure: Introduction, 2–3 body paragraphs, Conclusion.
Outline your main arguments and examples.
while_writing: Write a clear introduction that paraphrases the question and states your position (if required).
In body paragraphs, start with a clear topic sentence.
Develop each idea with reasons, explanations, and examples.
Use linking words to connect ideas within and between paragraphs.
In the conclusion, summarise your main points and restate your position (if required).
Keep paragraphs focused on one main idea.
after_writing: Re‑read the question to ensure you have answered it fully.
If the prompt requires a position, check that it is clear and consistent throughout.
Review your arguments – are they well‑developed?
Check your examples – are they relevant?
Examine your paragraph organisation and linking.
Proofread for grammar, vocabulary, and spelling errors.
